Skills: Acrobatics 5 ranks, Profession (sailor) 5 ranks, Stealth 5 ranks.
Special: A senior Eagle Knight must invite the character into the organization.

constraints.summary: A Gray Corsair must be any nonevil.
A senior Eagle Knight must invite the character into the Gray Corsairs, and the character must choose an existing class as a gray focus to continue advancing.

profiles.playerSummary: A nonevil anti-slaver privateer of the Eagle Knights who picks a favored port for social and initiative bonuses, keeps advancing an earlier class through her gray focus, gains bonuses against known slavers, and eventually casts wind walk and word of recall to whisk her crew to freedom.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires any nonevil alignment, Sea Legs, Acrobatics/Profession (sailor)/Stealth 5 ranks, and a formal invitation from a senior Eagle Knight, and every gray boon depends on having levels in the specific class she chose as her gray focus.

profiles.name: Gray Gardener
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Gray Gardener, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Feats: Combat Reflexes.
Skills: Bluff 2 ranks, Diplomacy 2 ranks, Disguise 2 ranks, Intimidate 5 ranks, Perception 2 ranks, Sense Motive 5 ranks.
Spells: Able to cast 2nd-level divine spells.
Special: The character must publicly execute a tried and sentenced individual. Whether the victim is actually guilty or innocent is irrelevant.

constraints.summary: A Gray Gardener must have publicly executed a tried and sentenced individual, guilty or innocent.

profiles.playerSummary: A hooded, anonymous executioner of Galt’s Red Revolution who pronounces inquisitor-style judgments, enhances weapons with an escalating bane against chosen creature types, and eventually captures a slain foe’s soul in her blade or a magical guillotine while making that foe far harder to raise from the dead.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires Combat Reflexes, Bluff/Diplomacy/Disguise/Intimidate/Perception/Sense Motive ranks, 2nd-level divine spells, and proof of having publicly executed a sentenced individual, and several of her most powerful class features are only usable once per day or week.

profiles.name: Green Faith Acolyte
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Green Faith acolyte, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Any neutral.
Feats: Green Faith Acolyte (The Inner Sea World Guide 287).
Skills: Handle Animal 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, Survival 5 ranks.
Spells: Able to cast 3rd-level divine spells.

constraints.summary: A Green Faith acolyte must be any neutral.
A Green Faith acolyte climbs a strict hierarchy of titles -- Archdruid, Great Druid, Grand Druid -- earned or lost through formal challenges against rivals.

profiles.playerSummary: A neutral high priestess of the Green Faith who advances her animal companion and wild shape as if gaining druid levels, becomes immune to all poisons, and climbs a strict hierarchy of titles -- Archdruid, Great Druid, Grand Druid -- eventually casting extra spells each day and never aging.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires strict neutral alignment, the Green Faith Acolyte feat, Handle Animal/Knowledge (nature)/Survival 5 ranks, and 3rd-level divine spells, and reaching 9th and 10th level requires winning a formal challenge against a rival to claim each higher title.

profiles.name: Heritor Knight
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a heritor knight, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Alignment: Lawful good, lawful neutral, or neutral good.
Deity: Must worship Iomedae.
Skills: Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.
Feats: Iron Will, Skill Focus (Knowledge [religion]), Weapon Focus (longsword).

constraints.summary: A heritor knight must be lawful good, lawful neutral, or neutral good.
A heritor knight must worship Iomedae.

profiles.playerSummary: A longsword-wielding devotee of Iomedae who frees grappled or swallowed allies with a single strike, grounds flying foes, breaks undead special attacks and eventually destroys and redeems good-aligned undead outright, and comes to resemble the Inheritor herself, healing good creatures or smiting evil ones with a touch.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires a lawful-or-neutral good alignment, worship of Iomedae, base attack bonus +5, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Knowledge [religion]), Weapon Focus (longsword), and Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, and nearly every signature attack is built specifically around wielding a longsword.

profiles.name: Hinterlander
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a hinterlander, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Lawful good or neutral good.
Deity: Must worship Erastil.
Skills: Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, Survival 5 ranks.
Feats: Endurance, Weapon Focus (longbow).
Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level spells.

constraints.summary: A hinterlander must be lawful good or neutral good.
A hinterlander must worship Erastil.

profiles.playerSummary: A good-aligned Erastil-worshiping bow guardian of rural frontier villages who gains a favored enemy and a stack of ranger-style bonus archery feats, senses unnatural threats near a defended hearth, and eventually creates waymarkers to teleport back and protect the settlements she guards.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires a good alignment, worship of Erastil, Endurance, Weapon Focus (longbow), Knowledge (nature)/Survival 5 ranks, and 1st-level spells, and most of her signature bonuses only apply near a small settlement of 2,000 or fewer people.

profiles.name: Inheritor's Crusader
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become an Inheritor’s crusader, a character must fulfill the following criteria:
Alignment: Lawful good.
Deity: Iomedae.
Feats: Iron Will.
Skills: Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, Sense Motive 5 ranks.
Special: Proficient in longsword, channel positive energy.

constraints.summary: An Inheritor’s crusader must be lawful good and follows a paladin-like code of conduct.
An Inheritor’s crusader must worship Iomedae.

profiles.playerSummary: A lawful good champion of Iomedae’s ideals who radiates a stronger aura of courage, uses channel energy or lay on hands to break charm and compulsion effects on herself or allies, and can strike a guilty target with an automatic-hit judgment of Iomedae while sparing the innocent entirely.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires lawful good alignment, worship of Iomedae, Iron Will, Knowledge (religion)/Sense Motive 5 ranks, longsword proficiency, and channel positive energy, and the class is only 3 levels long, so it is a short capstone layered onto an existing cleric or paladin.

profiles.name: Inner Sea Pirate
profiles.sourceCitationText: Pirates of the Inner Sea pg. 24
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become an Inner Sea pirate, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Any nonlawful.
Skills: Appraise 5 ranks, Profession (sailor) 5 ranks, Swim 5 ranks.

constraints.summary: An Inner Sea pirate must be any nonlawful.

profiles.playerSummary: A nonlawful Inner Sea buccaneer who gains a growing rogue-style sneak attack and picks up a flexible menu of pirate tricks -- from a favored tavern where she drinks for free to lightning-fast quick appraisal, storm-savvy sailing, and combat tricks that trip or disarm sneak-attacked foes.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires any nonlawful alignment and Appraise/Profession (sailor)/Swim 5 ranks, and she gains no armor proficiency at all, so she stays lightly armored and reliant on Dexterity and precision damage.

profiles.name: Lantern Bearer
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Lantern Bearer, a character must fulfill the following criteria.
Alignment: Any good.
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Skills: Knowledge (dungeoneering) 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 2 ranks, Survival 5 ranks. Weapon Proficiency: Must be proficient with the longbow (or composite longbow) and one martial melee weapon.

constraints.summary: A Lantern Bearer must be any good.

profiles.playerSummary: A good-aligned elf-led anti-demon and anti-drow scout who gains a growing suite of light- and protection-themed spell-like abilities, a favored enemy, and cold-iron-treated weapons, eventually shrugging off entangling terrain, teleporting via elf gates, and bathing herself in a holy aura once per day.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires a good alignment, base attack bonus +5, Knowledge (dungeoneering)/Survival 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 2 ranks, and proficiency with the longbow and a martial melee weapon, and most of her signature spell-like abilities are limited to a small number of uses per day even at high level.

profiles.name: Liberator
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a liberator, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.
Alignment: Any nonlawful.
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Skills: Escape Artist 6 ranks, Open Lock 6 ranks.
Feats: Improved Sunder, Power Attack, Stealthy.

constraints.summary: A liberator must be any nonlawful.

profiles.playerSummary: A nonlawful jailbreaker who inspires rescued captives with a rallying cry, silently breaks locks and shackles at a discount, sunders objects without noise, and eventually gains permanent freedom of movement she can share with others once per day.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires any nonlawful alignment, base attack bonus +5, Escape Artist/Open Lock 6 ranks, and Improved Sunder, Power Attack, and Stealthy, and most of her defining tricks revolve narrowly around picking locks, breaking bindings, and sundering objects rather than raw combat power.

profiles.name: Lion Blade
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Lion Blade, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Any neutral.
Feats: Deceitful, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perform).
Skills: Bluff 3 ranks, Disguise 5 ranks, Stealth 5 ranks, either Perform (sing) or Perform (act) 3 ranks.
Special: Inspire competence bardic performance, servant of Taldor or the Sovereign Court affiliation, sneak attack +2d6.

constraints.summary: A Lion Blade must be any neutral.
A Lion Blade must be a servant of Taldor or the Sovereign Court and trained in the secret Shadow Schools.

profiles.playerSummary: A neutral Taldan spy trained in the Shadow Schools who moves effortlessly through crowds, slows or immobilizes foes with a sneak attack, casts suggestion on a flat-footed target, and eventually resists mind-affecting and divination magic well enough to fake being affected by it.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires any neutral alignment, Deceitful/Improved Initiative/Skill Focus (Perform), Bluff/Disguise/Stealth/Perform ranks, inspire competence, a Taldor/Sovereign Court affiliation, and sneak attack +2d6, and most of her signature abilities only work while surrounded by crowds or against unaware targets.

profiles.name: Living Monolith
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a living monolith, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Feats: Endurance, Iron Will.
Languages: Ancient Osiriani, Sphinx.
Skills: Knowledge (engineering) 4 ranks, Knowledge (history) 4 ranks, Knowledge (religion) 2 ranks.
Special: Must have a handcrafted stone scarab worth at least 1,000 gp created and bound to his forehead in a sacred ritual with at least one sphinx or living monolith present.

constraints.summary: A living monolith must have a handcrafted stone scarab worth at least 1,000 gp bound to his forehead in a sacred ritual with a sphinx or living monolith present.

profiles.playerSummary: An Osirian tomb guardian bound to a stone scarab who grows into damage reduction, immunity to disease, and critical-hit fortification, enlarges himself with sacred power, and eventually becomes immortal, immune to petrification and energy drain, and able to melt into stone or commune with the dead.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires base attack bonus +5, Endurance, Iron Will, Ancient Osiriani and Sphinx, Knowledge (engineering)/Knowledge (history)/Knowledge (religion) ranks, and a costly ritual binding a stone scarab to his forehead, and his best growth abilities depend on choosing a ka stone (mostly martial) or ib stone (spellcasting) at 1st level, a choice that cannot be changed.

profiles.name: Low Templar
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a low templar, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.
Feats: Mounted Combat, Weapon Focus (any martial weapon).
Skills: Bluff 5 ranks, Knowledge (nobility or planes) 2 ranks, Ride 5 ranks.
profiles.playerSummary: A self-serving Worldwound crusader who fights demons well while chasing his own agenda -- gaining bonuses against chaotic evil outsiders, dirty tricks on critical hits, and a flexible alignment-masking loophole -- and eventually gains a bonded planar cohort matching whichever ethical path he ultimately chooses.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires Mounted Combat, Weapon Focus (any martial weapon), and Bluff/Knowledge (nobility or planes)/Ride ranks, and his identity is built around moral compromise -- he must eventually pick a path of darkness or light and later damnation or redemption to unlock his best abilities.

profiles.name: Magaambyan Arcanist
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Magaambyan arcanist, a character must fulfill the following criteria.
Alignment: Any good.
Feats: Scholar, Spell Mastery.
Skills: Spellcraft 5 ranks, Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks.
Spells: Ability to prepare 3rd-level arcane spells.

constraints.summary: A Magaambyan arcanist must be any good.

profiles.playerSummary: A good-aligned scholar of the Magaambya who translates druidic spells onto her arcane list, casts good-descriptor spells at higher caster level with extended durations, flexibly re-masters and re-slots spells throughout the day, and eventually redirects harmful effects from her allies onto herself.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires a good alignment, Scholar and Spell Mastery, Spellcraft/Knowledge (arcana)/Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, and the ability to prepare 3rd-level arcane spells, and nearly her entire kit revolves around the Spell Mastery feat and good-descriptor spells rather than raw arcane power.

profiles.name: Mystery Cultist
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a mystery cultist, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria:
Alignment: Any good.
Feats: Celestial Obedience (see page 5).
Language: Celestial.
Skills: Knowledge (religion) 7 ranks.
Special: Must worship an empyreal lord.
Special: Must have been spiritually awakened by the presence of a celestial being—either by being rescued from the brink of death by a willing good outsider of CR 5 or greater or by being the recipient of a beneficial spell or effect from a celestial being of CR 10 or greater.

constraints.summary: A mystery cultist must be any good, and loses all class features if she stops being good or goes against her patron’s will.
A mystery cultist must worship an empyreal lord and perform a daily obedience to maintain her abilities.

profiles.playerSummary: A devout worshiper of an empyreal lord who radiates a frightening aura of divine beauty, summons celestial allies, brands allies with a healing mark of light, and eventually enters a righteous fervor that boosts her attacks and caster level while granting damage reduction against evil.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires a good alignment, the Celestial Obedience feat, Celestial, Knowledge (religion) 7 ranks, worship of an empyreal lord, and proof of a prior brush with a powerful celestial, and losing her alignment or defying her patron strips every class feature -- including enhanced spellcasting -- until she atones.

profiles.name: Noble Scion
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a noble scion, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Feats: Noble Scion (The Inner Sea World Guide 288) or Skill Focus (any skill that’s a class skill for this prestige class).
Skills: Bluff 2 ranks, Diplomacy 2 ranks, Knowledge (nobility) 5 ranks, Sense Motive 2 ranks.
Special: Must have been granted noble rights, be part of the aristocracy, or have been born, married, or adopted into a noble family.

constraints.summary: A noble scion must have noble rights, be part of the aristocracy, or have been born, married, or adopted into a noble family.

profiles.playerSummary: A wealthy aristocrat who draws a growing gold stipend and a pool of favors and influence each week, recruits a cohort through bonus Leadership, picks region-flavored bonus feats and dilettante studies that dabble in spellcasting, sneak attack, or bardic performance, and eventually takes the best of two rolls on key social checks.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires the Noble Scion feat or a relevant Skill Focus, Bluff/Diplomacy/Knowledge (nobility)/Sense Motive ranks, and genuine noble status by birth, marriage, adoption, or grant, and most of his resource-based abilities (stipend, influence pool, servitor) only function meaningfully in settlements of real size.

profiles.name: Pain Taster
profiles.requirementsText:
To become a pain taster, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.
Feats: Diehard, Endurance, Great Fortitude.
Skills: Heal 5 ranks, Intimidate 5 ranks.
Alignment: Any nongood.
Special: The candidate must survive a special ritual designed to inure her to pain.

constraints.summary: A pain taster must be any nongood.
A pain taster must survive a costly ritual designed to inure her to pain before gaining any levels, and must repeat a costly torture ritual to change her ongoing self-torture routine.

profiles.playerSummary: A nongood self-torturer, often Kuthite, who takes a daily torture routine for a lasting ability-score boost, self-inflicts damage as a swift action for combat bonuses, wields a whip with growing sneak-attack-style cruelty, and builds up damage reduction as her body hardens against pain.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires Diehard, Endurance, Great Fortitude, Heal/Intimidate 5 ranks, any nongood alignment, and surviving an initial pain ritual, and her signature masochism and disciple-of-pain abilities both cost real hit points or gold to activate and maintain.

profiles.name: Pathfinder Delver
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Pathfinder delver, a character must fulfill the following criteria.
Skills: Acrobatics 5 ranks, Disable Device 4 ranks, Knowledge (history) 4 ranks, Perception 5 ranks.
Special: Must have recovered an object of historical significance from an ancient ruin or similar historic location. The nature of this object can vary, but it must be presented to a Pathfinder Lodge and be verified by an agent there. The object need not be handed over to the Society— in most cases, these objects are ancient magical items discovered in the course of adventuring and remain in the possession of the Pathfinder delver. Ioun stones are some of the more commonly presented items for this purpose.

constraints.summary: A Pathfinder delver must have recovered an object of historical significance from an ancient ruin and had it verified by an agent at a Pathfinder Lodge.

profiles.playerSummary: A thrill-seeking Pathfinder ruin-delver who disarms and bypasses traps with rogue-like ease, moves through difficult terrain at full speed, delays a just-triggered trap’s activation, and eventually cheats death once per day by dropping to -1 hit points instead of dying outright.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires Acrobatics/Disable Device/Knowledge (history)/Perception ranks and proof of recovering and presenting a historically significant object to a Pathfinder Lodge, and his kit is built almost entirely around traps, exploration, and survival rather than direct combat output.

profiles.name: Pathfinder Field Agent
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Pathfinder field agent, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.
Feats: Skill Focus (any).
Skills: Knowledge (any) 5 ranks, Linguistics 1 rank, Perception 1 rank.
Special: Must be an active member of the Pathfinder Society and own a wayfinder.

constraints.summary: A Pathfinder field agent must be an active member of the Pathfinder Society and own a wayfinder.

profiles.playerSummary: A versatile Pathfinder Society explorer who picks Pathfinder training freely from a wide menu -- trapfinding, rogue talents, extra spellcasting, sneak attack, superior Knowledge recall -- while steadily upgrading a signature wayfinder with new magical tricks like daylight, silence, or hidden compartments.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires Skill Focus (any), Knowledge (any) 5 ranks, Linguistics/Perception 1 rank, and active Pathfinder Society membership with an owned wayfinder, and her signature wayfinder upgrades only function on an unmodified standard wayfinder.

profiles.name: Prophet of Kalistrade
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a prophet of Kalistrade, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Lawful neutral.
Skills: Knowledge (local) 5 ranks, Profession (merchant) 5 ranks, Sense Motive 2 ranks.
Special: Must follow the Prophecies of Kalistrade.

constraints.summary: A prophet of Kalistrade must be lawful neutral and follow the strict dietary and sexual prohibitions of the Prophecies of Kalistrade, losing all class features if he violates them.

profiles.playerSummary: A lawful neutral Drumite merchant-prophet who casts a small selection of divination and enchantment spells, can burn gold to cast known spells beyond his daily limit, gains AC and save bonuses for wearing enough decorative wealth, and eventually hides a chest of goods on the Ethereal Plane.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires lawful neutral alignment, Knowledge (local)/Profession (merchant) 5 ranks, Sense Motive 2 ranks, and following the Prophecies of Kalistrade’s strict dietary and sexual restrictions, and several of his best abilities require spending large sums of real gold that vanish forever.

profiles.name: Pure Legion Enforcer
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Pure Legion enforcer, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Any lawful.
Deity: Cannot worship a deity.
Feats: Godless HealingISWG.
Skills: Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, Sense Motive 4 ranks.
Special: Cannot cast divine spells.

constraints.summary: A Pure Legion enforcer must be any lawful and cannot worship a deity or cast divine spells.

profiles.playerSummary: A lawful, godless Rahadoumi zealot who detects and identifies divine magic and paraphernalia at will, demoralizes worshipers of a specific deity, disrupts a divine spellcaster’s connection to their god on a critical hit, and eventually gains spell resistance specifically against divine magic.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires any lawful alignment, the Godless Healing feat, Knowledge (religion)/Sense Motive ranks, and an inability to worship any deity or cast divine spells, and nearly every class feature is aimed narrowly at divine spellcasters and religious targets rather than combat generally.

profiles.name: Riftwarden
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Riftwarden, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Any nonevil.
Feats: Spell Focus (abjuration), Spell Penetration.
Skills: Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.
Special: Able to speak Abyssal and Infernal.
Spells: Able to cast magic circle against evil as a spell or spell-like ability.

constraints.summary: A Riftwarden must be any nonevil.

profiles.playerSummary: A nonevil planar guardian who counterspells summon spells and teleportation effects on the fly, channels baneful energy against extraplanar creatures, gains a customizable set of favored-enemy-style bonuses against planes and outsider subtypes, and eventually redirects and damages any creature teleporting nearby.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires any nonevil alignment, Spell Focus (abjuration), Spell Penetration, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks, Abyssal and Infernal, and the ability to cast magic circle against evil, and her whole kit is built around countering summoning and teleportation rather than general combat.

profiles.name: Rivethun Emissary
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a Rivethun emissary, a character must fulfill the following criteria.
Feats: Iron Will, Spirit Beacon.
Skills: Diplomacy 5 ranks, Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.
Special: Must have a familiar or spirit animal.

constraints.summary: A Rivethun emissary must have a familiar or spirit animal and belongs to a rare, secretive dwarven tradition considered an abomination by many other dwarves.

profiles.playerSummary: A rare dwarven spirit-bonded mystic who fuses her spirit animal with a summoned outsider to create a powerful animus companion, detects undead, fey, and outsiders, substitutes Wisdom for a physical ability score in a pinch, and eventually communes with her animus for a single answered question.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires Iron Will, the Spirit Beacon feat, Diplomacy/Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, and an existing familiar or spirit animal, and her signature animus ability requires staying within 30 feet of her spirit animal and is limited to a small number of daily uses.

profiles.name: Rose Warden
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a rose warden, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Chaotic good.
Deity: Must worship Milani.
Skills: Disguise 5 ranks, Stealth 5 ranks.
Feats: Iron Will.

constraints.summary: A rose warden must be chaotic good.
A rose warden must worship Milani.

profiles.playerSummary: A chaotic good revolutionary of Milani who moves freely through crowds while gaining a growing rogue-style sneak attack, picks rogue talents and insurgent techniques like holy-aligned weapon thorns or teleporting through narrow gaps, and eventually smites lawful or evil foes with extra sneak attack damage and a staggering blow.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires chaotic good alignment, worship of Milani, Disguise/Stealth 5 ranks, and Iron Will, and most of her signature bonuses (street sentinel, voice of the masses) only function in urban or crowded settings.

profiles.name: Runeguard
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a runeguard, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Alignment: Lawful good, neutral good, or chaotic good.
Deity: Must worship Soralyon.
Skills: Linguistics 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks.
Feats: Scribe Scroll.
Language: Thassilonian.
Spells: Able to cast 3rd-level spells.

constraints.summary: A runeguard must be lawful good, neutral good, or chaotic good.
A runeguard must worship Soralyon.

profiles.playerSummary: A good-aligned Thassilonian rune scholar of Soralyon who masters virtuous runes -- transferring spells by touch, doubling healing, granting insight bonuses through aid another, or forging telepathic bonds -- and boosts the save DCs of glyph, symbol, and language-dependent spells she casts.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires a good alignment, worship of Soralyon, Linguistics/Spellcraft 5 ranks, Scribe Scroll, Thassilonian, and 3rd-level spells, and every virtuous rune costs an attack-of-opportunity-provoking standard action and a limited number of daily uses shared across all seven runes.

profiles.name: Sacred Sentinel
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a sacred sentinel, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.
Base Attack Bonus: +6.
Alignment: Lawful good.
Deity: Must worship Torag.
Feats: Endurance, Toughness.
Special: Proficiency with light, medium, and heavy armor and all shields (other than tower shields).

constraints.summary: A sacred sentinel must be lawful good and follows the paladin’s code of Torag, losing all class features for 24 hours if she violates it.
A sacred sentinel must worship Torag.

profiles.playerSummary: A lawful good dwarven defender of Torag who grants nearby allies a growing CMD and stabilization bonus, heals by touch at range through her protective aura, tempers healed allies with bonus AC and saves, and eventually clings to life for one extra round when killed while protecting her charges.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires lawful good alignment, worship of Torag, base attack bonus +6, Endurance, Toughness, and proficiency with heavy armor and shields, and nearly every ability only functions while her strategic protection aura is active and allies stay close by.

profiles.name: Sanguine Angel
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a sanguine angel, a character must fulfill the following criteria.
Alignment: Lawful evil, lawful neutral, or neutral evil.
Armor Proficiency: Proficient with heavy armor.
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Feats: Improved Shield Bash, Iron Will, Weapon Focus (longsword).
Gender: Female.
Language: Infernal.

constraints.summary: A sanguine angel must be lawful evil, lawful neutral, or neutral evil.
A sanguine angel must be a female member of the Erinyes Company, a Chelish military unit.

profiles.playerSummary: A ruthless female sword-and-shield soldier of Cheliax’s Erinyes Company who picks combat disciplines like bull-rush charges or ally-swapping footwork, gains a bonus against Intimidate, later pierces illusions with true seeing and dominates a target once per day, and finally transforms into a winged infernal outsider.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires lawful-or-evil-neutral alignment, female gender, heavy armor proficiency, base attack bonus +5, Improved Shield Bash, Iron Will, Weapon Focus (longsword), and Infernal, and several capstone abilities only function while wielding a longsword and shield or wearing specific Gray Maiden plate armor.

profiles.name: Scar Seeker
profiles.requirementsText:
To qualify to become a scar seeker, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Alignment: Lawful good or neutral good.
Deity: Must worship Vildeis.
Skills: Heal 3 ranks, Intimidate 3 ranks, Knowledge (religion) 3 ranks.
Feats: Toughness.

constraints.summary: A scar seeker must be lawful good or neutral good.
A scar seeker must worship Vildeis.

profiles.playerSummary: A good-aligned scarification devotee of Vildeis who unlocks a growing menu of enduring scars -- a vicious weapon buff, doubled lay on hands healing at self-cost, damage reduction, or sharing an ally’s damage -- and can push past his daily limit by taking real Hit-Dice-scaled damage, eventually sacrificing himself for allies in a final act.
profiles.tradeoff: Entry requires a good alignment, worship of Vildeis, base attack bonus +5, Toughness, and Heal/Intimidate/Knowledge (religion) ranks, and his signature painful purification ability lets him exceed his daily uses only by taking real damage that only a full night’s rest can heal.
